author: John Owen
subtitle_en: Living by the Spirit to Put to Death the Deeds of the Body
subtitle_tet: Moris Hodi Espíritu Atu Oho Hahalok Isin Nian

cards.scripture_en: "If ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live" (Rom 8:13).
cards.scripture_tet: "Se imi liuhosi Espíritu oho hahalok isin nian, imi sei moris" (Roma 8:13).
cards.body_en: If ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live (Rom 8:13). Indwelling sin lives in us in some measure and degree while we are in this world. We dare not speak as though we had already attained, either were already perfect (Phil 3:12). To be daily employing the Spirit and new nature for the mortifying of sin is the indispensable duty of every believer. He that ceases from this combat is in danger of being hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
cards.body_tet: Se imi liuhosi Espíritu oho hahalok isin nian, imi sei moris (Roma 8:13). Sala ne'ebé hela iha ita moris iha ita ho medida no grau ruma enkuantu ita iha mundu ne'e. Ita la brani ko'alia hanesan ita to'o ona, ka perfeitu ona (Filipe 3:12). Uza loron-loron Espíritu no natureza foun atu oho sala mak devér indispensável husi fiar-na'in ida-idak. Ema ne'ebé para husi luta ida-ne'e iha perigu atu sai toos liuhosi bosok sala nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Believers have a daily duty to mortify indwelling sin through the Spirit while in this world, lest sin harden the heart.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fiar-na'in sira iha devér loron-loron atu oho sala ne'ebé hela iha laran liuhosi Espíritu enkuantu iha mundu ne'e, atu sala la halo fuan toos.

cards.section_heading_en: The Spirit Alone is the Mortifier
cards.scripture_en: "For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live" (Rom 8:13).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba se imi moris tuir isin, imi sei mate; maibé se imi liuhosi Espíritu oho hahalok isin nian, imi sei moris" (Roma 8:13).
cards.body_en: Mortification is the work of the Spirit. All self-made mortifications—monastic vows, rigid penances, human resolutions without grace—are utterly in vain. They are like mending a hole in the wall while the house is on fire. Poor souls set themselves to keep down sin by terrifying legal rules, but being strangers to the Spirit and Christ, they remain in slavery all their days. The Holy Spirit alone brings the efficacy of the cross to the soul.
cards.body_tet: Oho sala mak serbisu Espíritu nian. Esforsu hotu ne'ebé halo rasik—votu monástiku, peniténsia todan, rezolusaun umanu sein grasa—sau-fatin de'it. Sira hanesan taka kuak ida iha parede enkuantu uma ahi han hela. Klamar kiak sira koko hanehan sala ho regra legál ne'ebé halo tauk, maibé tanba la hatene Espíritu no Kristu, sira hela iha escravidaun loron hotu. Espíritu Santu mesak mak lori efikásia krús nian ba klamar.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Only the Holy Spirit can truly mortify sin by applying the power of the cross; self-effort and legalism fail.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Espíritu Santu mesak mak bele oho sala ho loos hodi aplika podér krús nian; esforsu rasik no legalizmu falla.

cards.section_heading_en: What True Mortification Is and Is Not
cards.section_heading_tet: Saida Mak Oho Sala Loos no La'ós
cards.scripture_en: "Crucify the flesh with the affections and lusts" (Gal 5:24).
cards.scripture_tet: "Kruzifika isin hamutuk ho afeisaun no hakarak aat sira" (Galásia 5:24).
cards.body_en: Mortification consists not in the utter destruction of sin while we are in the flesh, nor in a quiet, undisturbed natural disposition, nor in a mere outward diversion from actual sin. True mortification is the habitual weakening of the root and power of lust, a constant fighting against sin's first motions, and obtaining frequent victories over it through the Holy Spirit.
cards.body_tet: Oho sala la konsiste iha destruisaun kompletu sala nian enkuantu ita iha isin, ka iha dispozisaun naturál ne'ebé kalma no la hetan perturbaun, ka iha divertimentu iha li'ur de'it husi sala atual. Oho sala loos mak enfraquesimentu habitual husi abut no podér hakarak aat nian, luta kontínua hasoru movimentu dahuluk sala nian, no hetan vitória barak hasoru ida-ne'e liuhosi Espíritu Santu.
cards.key_takeaway_en: True mortification weakens the root and power of lust habitually through the Spirit rather than erasing sin completely in this life.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Oho sala loos enfrakesa abut no podér hakarak aat nian ho habitualmente liuhosi Espíritu duké halakon sala hotu iha moris ne'e.

cards.section_heading_tet: Sintoma Perigozu Sira Husi Sala Ne'ebé Hela Iha Laran
cards.scripture_en: "Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light" (Eph 5:14).
cards.scripture_tet: "Hadeer ó ne'ebé dukur, no hamriik husi mate, no Kristu sei fó naroman ba ó" (Éfezu 5:14).
cards.body_en: Look upon your heart when a lust has long abided in you. Dangerous symptoms appear when sin gets inveterateness, when it exerts itself without notice, when conscience is pacified with false remedies without Christ’s blood, or when a man fights against sin only with legal fears of punishment. If you find these symptoms, awake! You are fast asleep in a storm of God’s anger.
cards.body_tet: Haree ba ó-nia fuan bainhira hakarak aat ida hela kleur ona iha ó. Sintoma perigozu sira mosu bainhira sala sai inveteradu, bainhira nia halo serbisu sein repara, bainhira konsiénsia hakalma ho remédiu falsu sein Kristu nia raan, ka bainhira ema ida funu hasoru sala ho tauk legál kastigu nian de'it. Se ó hetan sintoma sira-ne'e, hadeer! Ó dukur metin iha tempestade hirus Maromak nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Chronic sin, unexamined lust, false peace without Christ's blood, or mere legal fear are dangerous spiritual warning signs.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Sala króniku, hakarak aat ne'ebé la ezamina, dame falsu sein Kristu nia raan, ka tauk legál de'it mak sinál avizu espirituál ne'ebé perigozu.

cards.section_heading_en: Clear Sense of Sin's Guilt and Evil
cards.section_heading_tet: Sentidu Klaru Kona-Ba Kulpa no Aat Sala Nian
cards.scripture_en: "They shall look upon me whom they have pierced" (Zech 12:10).
cards.scripture_tet: "Sira sei hateke ba Ha'u ne'ebé sira sona" (Zacarias 12:10).
cards.body_en: Get a clear and abiding sense upon your mind and conscience of the guilt, danger, and evil of that sin wherewith you are perplexed. Load your conscience with the guilt of sin from the holiness of the Law, and even more from the grace of the Gospel. Look on Him whom you have pierced! Say to your soul, What have I done? What love, what mercy, what blood have I despised to harbor a lust!
cards.body_tet: Hetan sentidu klaru no permanente iha ó-nia hanoin no konsiénsia kona-ba kulpa, perigu no aat husi sala ne'ebé halo ó konfuzaun. Karga ó-nia konsiénsia ho kulpa sala nian husi santidade Lei nian, no liután husi grasa Evanjellu nian. Hateke ba Nia ne'ebé ó sona! Dehan ba ó-nia klamar, Saida mak ha'u halo ona? Domin saida, laran-sadia saida, raan saida mak ha'u hakribi atu rai hakarak aat ida!
cards.key_takeaway_en: See sin's guilt against God's holiness and especially Christ's pierced love and blood on the cross.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Haree kulpa sala nian hasoru santidade Maromak nian no liuliu Kristu nia domin no raan ne'ebé sona iha krús.

cards.section_heading_en: Constant Longing for Deliverance and Watchfulness
cards.section_heading_tet: Hakarak Kontínuu Ba Libertasaun no Vijilánsia
cards.scripture_en: "O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?" (Rom 7:24).
cards.scripture_tet: "Oh ema kiak no terus-na'in ha'u! Sé mak sei liberta ha'u husi isin mate nian ne'e?" (Roma 7:24).
cards.body_en: Constantly long for deliverance from the power of sin. Sigh and groan for freedom, as Paul did: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? (Rom 7:24). Watch against sin’s first advantages and occasions. Rise at the very first evidence of sin’s working in your thoughts, before it gathers strength and entangles your affections.
cards.body_tet: Hakarak nafatin libertasaun husi podér sala nian. Halerik no tanis ba liberdade, hanesan Paulo halo: Oh ema kiak no terus-na'in ha'u! Sé mak sei liberta ha'u husi isin mate nian ne'e? (Roma 7:24). Vijila hasoru vantajen no okaziaun dahuluk sala nian. Hamriik iha evidénsia dahuluk serbisu sala nian iha ó-nia hanoin, antes nia halibur forsa no kesi ó-nia afeisaun.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Cry out for deliverance from sin's power and watch against its earliest motions before temptation takes root.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Halerik ba libertasaun husi podér sala nian no vijila hasoru ninia movimentu dahuluk antes tentasaun hariis abut.

cards.section_heading_en: Set Faith at Work on Christ Crucified
cards.section_heading_tet: Halo Fiar Serbisu Ba Kristu Ne'ebé Kruzifika
cards.scripture_en: "And the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin" (1 John 1:7).
cards.scripture_tet: "No raan Jesus Kristu Ninia Oan-Mane hamoos ita husi sala hotu" (1 João 1:7).
cards.body_en: Set faith at work on Christ for the killing of your sin. His blood is the great sovereign remedy for sin-sick souls. Act faith peculiarly upon the death, blood, and cross of Christ. Consider that all supplies of the Spirit, all communications of grace and power, flow from His death. Bring Christ crucified into your heart daily by faith, and apply His blood to your corruptions.
cards.body_tet: Halo fiar serbisu ba Kristu atu oho ó-nia sala. Ninia raan mak remédiu soberanu boot ba klamar ne'ebé moras tanba sala. Hala'o fiar espesialmente ba mate, raan no krús Kristu nian. Konsidera katak fornesimentu hotu Espíritu nian, komunikasaun hotu grasa no podér nian, suli husi Ninia mate. Lori Kristu ne'ebé kruzifika tama iha ó-nia fuan loron-loron liuhosi fiar, no aplika Ninia raan ba ó-nia korrupsaun sira.
cards.key_takeaway_en: By faith look daily to Christ crucified, for all Spirit-given grace and power to kill sin flows from His death.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Liuhosi fiar hateke loron-loron ba Kristu ne'ebé kruzifika, tanba grasa no podér hotu husi Espíritu atu oho sala suli husi Ninia mate.

cards.section_heading_en: Conclusion - Life and Peace Through Gospel Mortification
cards.section_heading_tet: Konkluzaun - Moris no Dame Liuhosi Oho Sala Evanjéliku
cards.scripture_en: "If ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live" (Rom 8:13).
cards.scripture_tet: "Se imi liuhosi Espíritu oho hahalok isin nian, imi sei moris" (Roma 8:13).
cards.body_en: Live in this expectation of relief from Jesus Christ, and you will die a conqueror. Expectation of help from Christ engages Him to a full and speedy assistance. If ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live. Spiritual life, strength, joy, and peace in communion with God are the blessed fruits of gospel mortification.
cards.body_tet: Moris iha esperansa alíviu husi Jesus Kristu ne'e, no ó sei mate nu'udar manán-na'in. Esperansa ajuda husi Kristu envolve Nia ba asisténsia kompletu no lalais. Se imi liuhosi Espíritu oho hahalok isin nian, imi sei moris. Moris espirituál, forsa, ksolok no dame iha komuñaun ho Maromak mak fuan bensaun nian husi oho sala evanjéliku.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Expecting help from Christ through the Spirit brings victory, spiritual life, joy, and peace in fellowship with God.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Hein ajuda husi Kristu liuhosi Espíritu lori vitória, moris espirituál, ksolok no dame iha komuñaun ho Maromak.
